Name: (AT) Wildflour's Machines for Cozy Farmhouse Kitchen
Author: LunaLycan287
Description:
[size=5][left]Wildflour's Machines for Cozy Farmhouse Kitchen[/left][/size]
This mod adds Alternative Textures for the machines in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623?tab=user+files]Wildflour's mods[/url] to make them fit in with the aesthetic of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10473]Cozy Farmhouse Kitchen[/url].  
Both light version and dark version are available.

[size=4][left][size=5]Which Mod has which Machine?
[/size][/left][/size]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14778]Candy Pack[/url]
  - Confection Station
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15711]Chilly Treats Pack[/url]
  - Blast Chiller
  - Frozen Treat Maker
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14719]Coffee Pack[/url]
  - Coffee Brewer
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14834]Floral Goods Pack[/url]
  - Flower Station
  - Fragrance Station
  - Tub o' Wildflours / Wildflour Tub
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14886]Gourmet Pantry[/url]
  - Kitchen Blender
  - Kitchen Mortar
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14667]Tea Pack[/url]
  - Tea Kettle
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15609]Refreshing Beverages Pack[/url]
  - Boba Station
  - Juice Station
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13981]Specialty Ales and Meads[/url]
  - Ale Keg
  - Artisan Mead Keg

Ale Keg and Artisan Mead Keg can use each others texture, the one based on the other one is prefixed as "ALT" version.

[size=5][left]Credits / Thank[/left][/size]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflourmods[/url] for creating so many amazing mods.  
Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2816980]Alvadea[/url] for creating the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10473]Cozy Farmhouse Kitchen[/url] mod.

The base used from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflourmods[/url] were originally assets from Atlas's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14644]West Elm Furniture[/url] mod. Thank you for allowing me to use those assets.

[b]Note for Modders[/b]: If you want to build upon my changes, you will have to get permission to use those assets too!
